Comfortable beds in large dorms, key operated lockers, free computer access as well as WiFi in every room, free breakfast, complimentary coffee and tea, 24 hour bar, access to their professional kitchen. Very friendly and accommodating staff. 3-course Portuguese dinners for €8 by their in-house chef.
Area: Baixa; Address: Rua de São Julião 148; Price: 4 person dorms starting at €15

candidates.name: Sheraton Lisboa Hotel & Spa
candidates.text:
Sheraton Lisboa Hotel & Spa
Five-star, 369-room hotel with swimming pool, spa, gym, business centre, and free Wi-Fi. Its rooftop Panorama Restaurant and Bar offers superb views over Lisbon.
Area: North; Address: Rua Latino Coelho 1; Price: 150-251

candidates.name: Torel Palace Lisbon
candidates.text:
Torel Palace Lisbon
The four-star, 31-room Torel Palace is a boutique hotel on top of Sant'ana hill. From the carefully renovated two palaces and the outside gardens, terraces and the pool, visitors enjoy a stunning view over the city. Named after Portuguese Queens and Kings, each of the rooms is unique and offers an elegant home. Owned by a Portuguese and two Austrians. Offers breakfast all day long.
Area: Alfama; Address: Rua Câmara Pestana 23; Price: 127-242

candidates.name: Hotel Borges Chiado
candidates.text:
Hotel Borges Chiado
Three-star, 100-room hotel. Spacious rooms with satellite TV. Very central, but somewhat expensive for the service.
Area: Bairro Alto; Address: Rua Garrett 108; Price: 48-126

candidates.name: Hotel Travel Park Lisboa
candidates.text:
Hotel Travel Park Lisboa
Three-star, 61-room hotel that sits in the heart of Av. Almirante Reis. Just five minutes away from Lisbon International Airport and with underground station at doorstep.
Area: Alfama; Address: Avenida Almirante Reis 64; Price: 53-97

candidates.name: NH Collection Lisboa Liberdade
candidates.text:
NH Collection Lisboa Liberdade
Nice four-star, 108-room hotel in the center of the city. Seasonal rooftop pool, lawned terrace, bar, free Wi-Fi.
Area: Bairro Alto; Address: Avenida da Liberdade 180B; Price: 107-207

candidates.name: Holiday Inn Express Lisbon - Av. Liberdade
candidates.text:
Holiday Inn Express Lisbon - Av. Liberdade
Three-star, 108-room modern hotel with compact but efficient rooms, with kettle and mini-fridge. Near Avenida da Liberdade and the view from Parque Eduardo VII, and within walking distance of the old town. Nearby shops and restaurants are less crowded with tourists than those further south. Two metro lines give access to most areas of the city, and frequent bus 727 runs directly to the Belém museum district. Price includes breakfast and reliable wireless Internet access.
Area: Bairro Alto; Address: Rua Alexandre Herculano 40; Price: 90-174

candidates.name: Olissippo Lapa Palace
candidates.text:
Olissippo Lapa Palace
Five-star, 109-room hotel, property of Orient-Express Hotels, Trains & Cruises. A luxury palace hotel in one of Lisbon's seven hills, with gardens and pools, heated all year long. Member of the Leading Hotels of the World. With one of the best spas in Lisbon, gourmet food (its restaurant is considered by the Zagat Guide as one of the best in Lisbon) and one of the best concierge services in the country.
Area: Bairro Alto; Address: Rua do Pau de Bandeira 4; Price: 264-351

candidates.name: Eurostars das Letras
candidates.text:
Eurostars das Letras
Five-star, 107-room modern hotel in the central Rato district. The hotel offers free wireless internet for guests along with two laptops with internet access.
Area: Bairro Alto; Address: Rua Castilho, 6-12; Price: 91-268

candidates.name: Sofitel Lisbon Liberdade
candidates.text:
Sofitel Lisbon Liberdade
Five-star, 163-room hotel. Perhaps not particularly outstanding in standards or appointments among other Sofitels in Europe (meaning though that the standards are very high), the Lisbon Sofitel boasts a very central location on the Avenida da Liberdade, smack right at the entrance to the namesake metro station.
Area: Bairro Alto; Price: 174-264

candidates.name: Tivoli Avenida Liberdade Lisboa
candidates.text:
Tivoli Avenida Liberdade Lisboa
The five-star, 285-room flagship of the Portuguese Tivoli hotel chain is most known for its rooftop terrace bar with splendid views.
Area: Bairro Alto; Address: Avenida da Liberdade 185; Price: 180-304

candidates.name: Altis Grand Hotel
candidates.text:
Altis Grand Hotel
Five-star, 295 room hotel with swimming pool, spa, gym, business centre, conference facilities, bar, and free Wi-Fi.
Area: Bairro Alto; Address: Rua Castilho 11; Price: 101-240

candidates.name: Fontecruz Lisboa
candidates.text:
Fontecruz Lisboa
Striking postmodern architecture and interior appointments are on the menu throughout this Marriott's luxury, five-star, 72-room boutique hotel.
Area: Bairro Alto; Address: Av. da Liberdade 138-142; Price: 175-390

candidates.name: Grand Hyatt Dubai
candidates.text:
Grand Hyatt Dubai
A resort style hotel with extensive conference facilities and 13 restaurants serving cuisine from all over the world.
Area: Bur Dubai

candidates.name: Dubai Youth Hostel
candidates.text:
Dubai Youth Hostel
Reception 24/7. Pool, football field, chill-out garden, A/C in the room, small bar fridge. It's located next to a mosque so morning prayers may wake you. Stadium metro station and bus stop just 100 m from hostel, Lulu Hyper Market shopping center and supermarket nearby. Free safety deposit boxes (hang on to your key as they have stiff US$200 replacement fee). Clean rooms but unhelpful staff. You can walk there from Terminal 2. When you get out walk straight along 16th St to the end. It takes around 10 min. From terminal 1 or 3 you can take the metro to Union and transfer to Green Line (just take a train on the other side of the platform) to Stadium station (zone 1 fare, 2 dirhams). A taxi from terminal 1 or 3 costs around 40 dirhams. It is a branch of the UAE YHA, and only hostel in …
Area: Deira; Address: 39 Al Nahda Rd; Price: Dorm from 100 dirhams or US$27, breakfast included

candidates.name: Jebel Ali Beach Hotel
candidates.text:
Jebel Ali Beach Hotel
Pets are not allowed. Speaks Russian, English, German and Arabic. This luxurious resort hotel is located on the Arabian Gulf. It has 1km private beach surrounded by palm trees and sun loungers. All the rooms are bright and stylish and they have fresh air and scenic balcony.
Area: Jebel Ali; Address: Exit 13, Sheikh Zayed Road, Jebel Ali, Dubai

candidates.name: Hilton Dubai Jumeirah
candidates.text:
Hilton Dubai Jumeirah
Resort with a private beach. The hotel is only 10 floors which is dwarfed by nearby high-rises, but the location is lively and the pool/garden area is lush.
Area: Jumeirah; Address: Tower A, The Walk, Jumeirah Beach Residence

candidates.name: InterContinental Dubai Festival City
candidates.text:
InterContinental Dubai Festival City
498 rooms over 36 floors with views of the Dubai Creek and a 3800-m² event centre. Attached to the Festival Centre shopping mall.
Area: Suburbs and Hatta

candidates.name: Hyatt Regency Dubai
candidates.text:
Hyatt Regency Dubai
414 rooms and suites with views of the Persian Gulf. Host to Al Dawaar, Dubai's only revolving restaurant.
Area: Deira; Address: Deira Corniche

candidates.name: Premier Inn Dubai Investments Park Hotel
candidates.text:
Premier Inn Dubai Investments Park Hotel
This hotel offers, business services, multilingual staff, free wi-fi, Video Conferencing, night clubs, casinos, safe deposit box and swimming pool.
Area: Jebel Ali; Address: E311, Dubai 35118

candidates.name: Holiday Inn Dubai - Al Barsha
candidates.text:
Holiday Inn Dubai - Al Barsha
310 elegant rooms, a choice of 3 bars, choice of 2 fine dining restaurants and 6-storey high atrium and piano lounge. Gymnasium, roof top pool, massage rooms, sauna and spa.
Area: Jumeirah; Address: Sheikh Zayed Road, Al Barsha 1

candidates.name: The Meydan Hotel
candidates.text:
The Meydan Hotel
Stylish hotel with 285 furnished rooms. It is equipped with rooftop pool, fitness center, spas, recreations centers like tennis and target shooting games. Its restaurant is specialized in steaks, Italian and Asian cuisine. Ladies-only units are also available.
Area: Suburbs and Hatta; Address: Meydan Racecourse, Al Meydan Road, Nad Al Sheba

candidates.name: InterContinental Residence Suites Dubai Festival City
candidates.text:
InterContinental Residence Suites Dubai Festival City
Offers one-, two- and three-bedroom serviced suites with a choice between Creek and city views. Available for short or long stays.
Area: Deira

candidates.name: The Radisson Blu Residence, Dubai Marina
candidates.text:
The Radisson Blu Residence, Dubai Marina
5 km away from Jafza, and economic free zone. It has 152 apartments with scenic balcony, two restaurants with the convenience of onsite dining. They arrange variety of events from time to time.
Area: Jumeirah; Address: Plot No. 392-260 Street K Dubai Marina

candidates.name: Hotel ibis
candidates.text:
Hotel ibis
Located on Sheikh Zayed Road, next to Ski Dubai & Mall of the Emirates. This mid-range hotel has 204 cozy air-conditioned with bathtubs. Equipped with Italian restaurant, coffee shop and bar. Private indoor parking available.
Area: Suburbs and Hatta; Address: 2 A Street; Price: 129 dirham for a room with a double bed

candidates.name: Chelsea Gardens Hotel Apartments
candidates.text:
Chelsea Gardens Hotel Apartments
It has 169 well-appointed luxury comfortable and spacious apartment suites with modern interior. Upon request, they offer airport transfers.
Area: Jumeirah; Address: Discovery Gardens Zen 3, Building Number 7

candidates.name: Studio One
candidates.text:
Studio One
A hotel in Studio City with many great restaurants (including Italian, Mexican, and Irish cuisine). The rooms are filled with modern art-y decor, as is the lobby. It also has a pool.
Area: Suburbs and Hatta; Price: 151 dirham per night for a single room, however can be up to 900 depending on time of year

candidates.name: Emirates Grand Hotel
candidates.text:
Emirates Grand Hotel
It is a non-alcoholic hotel decorated with luxurious amenities. Equipped with stream rooms, hot tubs, sauna, roof top pool, fitness center and tennis court.
Area: Jumeirah; Address: Near Finance Centre, Metro Stop, Sheikh Zayed Road

candidates.name: Dusit Thani Dubai
candidates.text:
Dusit Thani Dubai
Beautiful surroundings with Asian hospitality and teak-wood furniture all around and Venetian blinds. champagne lounge available. They have 321 modern rooms equipped with high-speed Internet connections.
Area: Jumeirah; Address: 133 Sheikh Zayed Road

candidates.name: Hilton Dubai Al Habtoor City
candidates.text:
Hilton Dubai Al Habtoor City
The hotel is 44 floors and has 1004 guest rooms, 8 dining outlets and 21 meeting rooms. 10 minutes by car from Downtown Dubai.
Area: Jumeirah; Address: Al Habtoor City, Sheikh Zayed Road; Price: 546 dirham

candidates.name: Anantara World Islands Dubai Resort
candidates.text:
Anantara World Islands Dubai Resort
Beachfront resort located on the World Islands. Contains a Swimming pool, spa, Paddle court, Fitness centre, Water sports centre, Kids’ club and Games room
Area: Jumeirah; Address: 55VG+QWX South America - World Islands; Price: $417/night

candidates.name: The Heart of Europe
candidates.text:
The Heart of Europe
Complex of several European-themed hotels spanning six islands in the Europe section of the World Islands. Includes Spanish-themed Marbella resort, four French Riviera-themed hotels (complete with marketplace and discotheque), Italian-themed Portofino Hotel, British-inspired Hotel London, Artist Hotel, the Danish-style Hygge Hotel, the Sweden Beach house, and 133 floating villas
Area: Jumeirah; Address: P.O. Box 126732
